scripts.preinstall: sh -c 'rm -f package-lock.json yarn.lock; case "$npm_config_user_agent" in pnpm/*) ;; *) echo "Use pnpm instead" >&2; exit 1 ;; esac'
scripts.build: pnpm run typecheck && pnpm -r --if-present run build
scripts.build:railway: pnpm run typecheck && pnpm --filter @workspace/campus-core run build && pnpm --filter @workspace/api-server run build
scripts.build:vercel: pnpm run build:vercel:campus-core && pnpm run build:vercel:api-server && pnpm run build:vercel:mockup-sandbox
scripts.build:vercel:campus-core: pnpm run typecheck:libs && pnpm --filter @workspace/campus-core run typecheck && BASE_PATH=/ pnpm --filter @workspace/campus-core run build
scripts.build:vercel:api-server: pnpm run typecheck:libs && pnpm --filter @workspace/api-server run typecheck && pnpm --filter @workspace/api-server run build:vercel
scripts.build:vercel:mockup-sandbox: BASE_PATH=/ pnpm --filter @workspace/mockup-sandbox run build && pnpm --filter @workspace/mockup-sandbox run typecheck
scripts.typecheck: pnpm run typecheck:libs && pnpm -r --filter "./artifacts/**" --filter "./scripts" --if-present run typecheck
